posts.title: The Color of an Empty Room [Music]
posts.description: Sunday. The Color of an Emtpy Room is an original song by Ultimate Rick Jones. It marks the first time I worked with John Serrano, which would prove portentious for the future. The tune has slimy fingerprints from Lovecraft's "Cthulhu Mythos," specifically the story "The Hounds of Tindalos," by Frank Belknap Long. The Color of an Empty Room is available on Bandcamp . And free download codes are available on GetMusic .

posts.title: Sweet and Lowdown [Music]
posts.description: Saturday. Sweet and Lowdown is an original song by Ultimate Rick Jones. This one goes out to my fellow long-term relationship travelers. I wrote it for my wife, Romayne, and we've been together for more than 30 years now. If that sounds like you or what you aspire to, then I hope you enjoy it. Sweet and Lowdown is available on Bandcamp . And free download codes are available on GetMusic .

posts.title: Garden of Sin (new music)
posts.description: "Garden of Sin" is the first single from John Serrano's new album "The Green Light" Out Now Two artists featured on this song appear throughout the album. Joining John on vocals, is Mexican artist Zurdeik . Zurdeik has an amazing voice and an inquisitive, collaborative spirit that makes her a joy to work with. Zurdeik lends her talents to other songs on the upcoming album, including astounding work on "Goddess" and "For Her." And on saxophones we have Manuel Rivas (aka Tatorita Sax .) A long time collaborator on Ultimate Rick Jones songs, it's great to hear Manuel bring his surging energy to this tune. Manuel's work also appears throughout the album. I first got Zurdeik and Manuel to join forces on a cover of John's song Granada . They sounded great together there, and I'm delighted we've been able to pair them up here.
